description.value: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family tasked with ruling an inhospitable world where the only thing of value is the spice melange. Political betrayal forces Paul into the deep desert among the Fremen. There he must survive and fulfill an ancient destiny across the galaxy.
